subject: A secret confession about our most loyal users
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this email. But after 68 days, you deserve to know the truth about what we do for our long-term users.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. We have a list. It's not a public list, and we don't talk about it much. It's the list of users who've stuck with us for over two months. People like you. And we treat the people on that list... differently.

It's a simple rule of reciprocity. You've given our app a real shot, you've listened to more music and podcasts with it, you've probably even shown it to a friend. That loyalty means something to us. So we do something for you that we don't do for brand-new downloads. We give you exclusive, insider-level access to the features that make the biggest difference.

Starting today, your app has a hidden pathway unlocked. It's not a new button, it's a smarter way to use the built-in equalizer. Think of it as the 'audiophile mode'—presets tuned with an extra layer of detail that we only share after someone's had time to appreciate the basics. The 'Rock' setting now has more nuanced crunch. The 'Electronic' preset has sub-bass you can feel in your teeth.

Open the app right now. Go to the EQ, pick your favorite genre preset, and hit play on your most demanding track. Listen for the space between the notes, the clarity in the vocal, the punch in the kick drum. That's your thank you. P.S. This isn't a trial. This access is yours for as long as you're with us. Consider it a permanent backstage pass.
